title: Can't export any godot project which using c# on my computer in godot 4.x
body:
### Tested versions

I tried 4.1,4.2.2,4.3 (mono version),and all don't work.

### System information

Windows11

### Issue description

   I tried to export in editor, and it occurred : 
Error message:MSB3094: "DestinationFiles" refers to 1 item, while "SourceFiles" references 227 items. They must have the same number of items. C:Program Filesdotnetsdk8.0.404SdksMicrosoft.NET.SdktargetsMicrosoft.NET.Publish.targets(351,5);
    I have tried to reload all dotnet and download them again.And when I attempted to use cmd to export,it showed 
"_ERROR: Class 'EditorSettings' can only be instantiated by editor.
   at: instantiate (core/object/class_db.cpp:364)
ERROR: Could not load editor settings from path: C:/Users/ya'd'min/AppData/Roaming/Godot/editor_settings-4.tres
   at: create (editor/editor_settings.cpp:936)
     at: _editor_init (modules/gltf/register_types.cpp:63)
System.InvalidOperationException: The Godot editor API assembly is not loaded.
   at GodotPlugins.Main.LoadToolsAssembly(Char* nAssemblyPath, IntPtr unmanagedCallbacks, Int32 unmanagedCallbacksSize) in /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotPlugins/Main.cs:line 174
ERROR: FATAL: Condition "editor_plugin_obj == nullptr" is true.
   at: _editor_init_callback (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1202)_"
   I checked all the things and found nothing.I also tried to reinstall my editor,didn't work.The rest went well, including compilation, running dotnet publish command.
   I wish to know if there's any solution except reinstalling the system?

### Steps to reproduce

<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.2.2">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net6.0</TargetFramework>
    <TargetFramework Condition=" '$(GodotTargetPlatform)' == 'android' ">net7.0</TargetFramework>
    <TargetFramework Condition=" '$(GodotTargetPlatform)' == 'ios' ">net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <EnableDynamicLoading>true</EnableDynamicLoading>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Build.Framework" Version="17.12.6" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
